common: Production Ottoman–Aegean city-building parcel texture, opaque landscape 2.3:1. Reference image is only painterly material, daylight, camera and scale; do NOT copy its palace layout. High nearly overhead orthographic camera, roofs dominant, little vertical facade, matching reference. Ivory limestone, restrained terracotta, lead grey, muted olives; warm upper-left sunlight. Entire roof, functional courtyard and tiny contact shadows INSIDE the image; functional paving reaches canvas edges. NO surrounding roads, NO white frame, NO raised rectangular plinth, NO generic repeated U palace, NO four corner towers, NO twin tower monumental gate unless required by the subject, NO baked text/UI. Distinctive architectural silhouette easily recognized on a phone. Fill the parcel with actual functional complex and courtyard; no empty exterior border.

subjects.valilik: Governor's civil administration house: compact asymmetric limestone mansion with timber balconies, red hipped roofs, a registry portico and a small shaded receiving court. Clearly a residence, not a mosque or imperial palace.
subjects.kara_pazar: Black market: asymmetric dense group of low timber market sheds with dark olive and burgundy cloth awnings, crates, sacks, trade counters and narrow functional paved passages. No grand facade, no central dome, no palace enclosure.
subjects.siginak: Civilian shelter: long low limestone barrel-vault shelter with TWO broad stair entrances going underground, ventilation shafts, supplies and a shaded waiting courtyard. The roof is modest and low; no domes or palace towers.
subjects.tekke: Dervish lodge: one clear octagonal timber semahane with a muted GREEN pitched roof, small humble residential wings, shaded benches, a simple circular gathering court. No mosque dome, no monumental palace walls.
subjects.mabet: Tengri sanctuary: distinct carved wooden shrine with a stepped dark timber roof, a central open-air circular stone altar, two sacred poles and a restrained grove inside the functional courtyard. No mosque, minaret, palace or modern religious symbols.
subjects.karagoz: Karagöz shadow theatre: compact low timber theatre buildings with tiled roofs, one unmistakable open stage with a blank illuminated ivory screen under a burgundy canopy, an organized audience courtyard with wooden benches. No text on screen, no monumental gate or palace.

forest: Create a new WIDE 3:1 aerial Mediterranean woodland GAME-MAP texture. CRITICAL SCALE: draw approximately 400 SMALL individual tree crowns across the complete panoramic image. Each tree crown must occupy only 1–2 percent of IMAGE WIDTH; no foreground tree, no close-up giant tree. High aerial orthographic camera, predominantly small canopies and their tiny lower-right shadows, NOT close frontal trunks. Organic mixed olive, slim cypress and stone-pine groves, grey olive greens, warm beige dry ground, subdued clearings. Dense enough to read immediately as forest. Fine detail, not blurred, no repeating grid, no identical mirrored clusters, no text. This large woodland painting will be used as a narrow northward city-map extension; trees MUST be at the same small map scale as the original reference's distant trees.
wall: One isolated production game sprite: a STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL continuous Ottoman limestone city wall span with about twelve modest rectangular battlements. Wide 4:1 horizontal strip composition. Camera high elevated orthographic near-overhead, matching the attached city terrain's sunlight and painted stone materials. Warm ivory weathered limestone, natural grey-beige joints, a narrow visible upper walkway and a low front stone face. Span has flat HORIZONTAL ground baseline. No red brick stripes, no gold decoration, no large towers, no gates, no flags, no surrounding terrain, no plinth. No perspective slope baked into baseline. All stone and small contact shadow fully inside sprite. Transparent above and around wall. Wall must look like one coherent well-built fortification, not a series of separate toy cubes. No text/UI. This texture will be mapped along a measured bent ridge while its vertical faces stay upright.
tower: One isolated Ottoman Aegean fortification tower game sprite matching the attached terrain's realistic painterly camera and materials. A modest SQUAT octagonal ivory limestone watchtower, stone battlement crown with a simple open guard walkway, no roof cone. High elevated orthographic view, narrow visible upright front facade, warm upper-left sunlight. Weathered neutral beige stone with subtle mortar. No red brick bands, no gold finial, no bulging toy turret, no banners, no palace decoration, no giant buttresses. Small and grounded, straight vertical walls, footprint visible at base. Transparent background, no terrain square, no text. Entire tower including small contact shadow inside image. Portrait 2:3 composition, tightly framed. It must fit the low continuous limestone wall we are making.
